# Test fixtures

## `test-tone-c4.sid`

A synthetic PSID file that plays a continuous C4 (261.63 Hz) triangle tone. It
is generated by `scripts/generate-test-sid.ts` and is this project's own work,
not a tune from HVSC or any other collection. Regenerate it with:

```bash
bun run scripts/generate-test-sid.ts
```

It is used as the deterministic fixture for smoke tests, browser tests, the
soak, and the published-package check. It is not included in the npm package.

## `engine-goldens.json`

Recorded signal statistics for both engines, used by `test/engine-parity.test.ts`
to catch fidelity regressions between full native-parity runs. Never hand-edit:
regenerate with `bun run test:parity -- --update-goldens`, and only after native
parity is green.

## Real SID tunes

No copyrighted SID files are stored here. Tests that need real tunes use the
HVSC #85 corpus, which `scripts/hvsc-fixtures.mjs` downloads to a local cache
(`.cache/hvsc-85`) and integrity-checks. That cache is excluded from the
repository and from the published package.
